hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject after the first 10 eligible paired observations if none meets the entry rule: post-gas edge of at least 30 bps, gas price at or below 30000000 wei, and two consecutive eligible observations meeting that rule. Passing this screen is not acceptance; retain the original control and require the seven-day, 1000-observation acceptance gate. Quotes are not fills or earned returns.
hypotheses.name: Hypothesis: WETH–PONS–CASHCAT triangle at 0.005 WETH
hypotheses.rationale: The graph contains this WETH → PONS → CASHCAT → WETH route, using the 3000, 10000, and 10000 fee tiers. Hypothesis: a temporary relative-price mismatch across these three pools could produce a positive round-trip edge at this exact size, but only if fresh same-block quotes show at least 30 bps after applying a 1.5× gas-cost reserve. The 36 training quotes sampled other route/size combinations; none is evidence for this cell.

hypotheses.name: Hypothesis: WETH–CASHCAT–USDG triangle at 0.005 WETH
hypotheses.rationale: The graph contains this distinct WETH → CASHCAT → USDG → WETH route, using the 3000, 10000, and 10000 fee tiers. Hypothesis: a temporary price dislocation involving the CASHCAT–USDG pool could overcome the route’s fees and gas reserve at this exact size; it is worth testing only if fresh quotes satisfy the stated entry rule. No supplied training quote measures this route at this size, so its output and edge remain unknown.

limitations: Both selected route/size cells are unquoted in the supplied cohort and require fresh quotes; outputs must not be inferred by scaling other sizes.

analysis.summary: The six supplied observations contain 36 quotes at blocks 95046937–95053024, with gas prices of 20000000–20166000 wei. Neither proposed route/size cell is quoted in those observations. These are bounded paper experiments requiring fresh same-block quotes; the training data does not validate a forward result.
